implementation.behavior: Match a comparison between a dividend and a product containing its divisor. Emit quotient bounds guarded by both the original comparison and divisor sign. Preserve Euclidean division, arbitrary zero-divisor functions and the maximum premise/definition scope. No filename, answer heuristic, runtime external oracle or feature gate is used.
implementation.example: For b>0, a>=b*t implies div(a,b)>=t; a<b*t implies div(a,b)<t. Negative divisors use the Euclidean ceiling quotient and reversed non-strict consequences.
